piece_dvergrcask_description: In an iron-banded dvergr cask, mead needs less time to sit and ferment, and more of it emerges with all its intended properties.
piece_dvergrcrate_description: A sturdy dvergr crate, pegged together and sealed with resin, that keeps its contents dry even under the open sky.
piece_hangingsurtlingcore_description: A surtling core hung on a leather cord. It glows without fuel and never goes out, but gives off no warmth.
piece_celticidol_description: A weathered idol carved from stone by forgotten hands.
piece_runecarving_description: Runes burnt into wood or stone that smoulder like embers after dark. Write on it like a sign; every letter becomes a rune.
